text:
sarah: Quick check — onboarding for model "orion-13b-v2". We pulled weights from HF and mirrored to S3 staging. HF repo: https://huggingface.co/redwood/orion-13b-v2 (weights under /pytorch_model.safetensors). S3 mirror: s3://redwood-artifacts/orion/13b/v2/pytorch_model.safetensors. Can someone verify sha256 checksum + call out any tokenizer quirks? I ran a quick head and saw an ETag but want the SHA256 in registry before we promote.

raj: Which checksum are we trusting here — ETag or sha256 metadata? ETag can be misleading (multipart). Also who needs presign TTL for follow-up downloads?

sarah: We standardize on sha256 in the registry. Note: our uploads set ChecksumSHA256 metadata when mirror-job completes. If missing, run: `aws s3api head-object --bucket redwood-artifacts --key "orion/13b/v2/pytorch_model.safetensors" --query ChecksumSHA256 --output text`. If that returns null, compute locally after download: `shasum -a 256 pytorch_model.safetensors`.

tony: Tokenizer heads-up: this HF tokenizer is byte-level BPE but has a nonstandard BOS token id=50256 and no explicit eos mapping in tokenizer.json — caused a generation loop in fuzzer. Workaround: patch tokenizer_config or force eos at generation. Minimal patch:

```json
{
  "add_bos_token": false,
  "eos_token": ""
}
```

That avoids inserting extra BOS during prompt prep.

alyssa: I can update the artifact-registry once sha256 is confirmed. Please include `"origin":"hf"`, `mirrors` array and a short `tokenizer_notes` field. Example metadata I will upload: 

```json
{"name":"orion-13b-v2","sha256":"<sha256>","origin":"hf","mirrors":["s3://redwood-artifacts/orion/13b/v2/"],"tokenizer_notes":"byte-bpe add_bos:false"}
```

dev-ops-bot: mirror-job-45321 created (hf -> s3). status: queued.

ingest-bot: mirror-job-45321 finished: warnings: tokenizer.json token_id_map mismatch (vocab size 50258 vs expected 50257). Model auto-validate: SOFT_FAIL. Logs: /ops/artifacts/45321/logs

sarah: @raj can you grant `artifacts:orion` write for alyssa? She needs to push the registry entry to promote. Also want presign TTL for downstream e2e tests.

raj: granted `artifacts:orion` push to alyssa (IAM policy updated). Presign TTL default is 12h; can extend on request for large download jobs.

tony: Quick test: loading safetensors + patched tokenizer works with accelerate. If you prefer not to patch tokenizer, forcing `forced_eos_id=tokenizer.eos_token_id` on the generation call prevents runaway loops.

alyssa: I'll open the registry PR after I have the sha256 from the validation job. Also adding a tokenizer note referencing Tony's patch.

ingest-bot: validation started: 45321 (full). ETA ~8m.

ingest-bot: validation finished: OK (checksum matches sha256: 3f1c9b7a...), WARN: tokenizer_vocab_size mismatch 50258 vs expected 50257. Manual review required.

sarah: Great — checksum confirmed. We'll hold promotion until Alyssa's PR is merged. @alyssa drop the PR link when ready. I'll also run a perf smoke once registry entry is live.

alyssa: PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/infra/artifact-registry/pulls/89 — includes sha256: 3f1c9b7a... and tokenizer note (byte-bpe add_bos:false). CI running.

raj: Reviewed, looks good. :thumbsup:

sarah: Merging after CI passes. I'll update the release note and runbook with the tokenizer quirk and attach the validation logs. Thanks everyone.
